images.view: High aerial view from a distance, with the whole solar plant visible inside the frame.
images.subject: A solar power plant built around one colossal central tower with a brilliantly glowing receiver at its top.
images.detail: A few widely spaced concentric rings of tilted polished mirrors surround the tower, with broad bands of open snow between the rings, and the whole mirror field stays well inside the frame.
images.site: It stands on a flat plateau blanketed in deep white snow and snowdrifts at the top of a towering dark neutral grey rock cliff heavily covered with thick white snow and ice, open to the sky, on a frozen lifeless alien planet of bare rock, ice and wind-blown snow.
